_doc: Anchor chunks: recurring 2-3 word phrases of this series (scripts/anchors.py from the hand-picked list scripts/anchors/<series>[_deck].txt). k = normalized tokens (lowercase, letters/digits only, space separated) matched against gloss tokens in order; id = sha1('<series>[_deck]/<k>')[:8], the stable id review cards and learned state use; t = shown form; ko/en = short app-written meaning; n = number of letters it appears in; first = [letter id, message index] of the first appearance; letters = space-separated letter ids.
